name: @lucid-evolution/cml
description: cardano-multiplatform-lib WebAssembly build used by Lucid Evolution

scripts.build-local: rm -rf dist && cd rust/cml/wasm && WASM_BINDGEN_WEAKREF=1 wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../../../src/browser && WASM_BINDGEN_WEAKREF=1 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL=3 CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN_RUSTFLAGS='-C link-arg=-zstack-size=16777216' wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir ../../../src/node && cd ../../.. && pnpm clean-garbage
scripts.clean-garbage: for d in browser node; do rm -f src/$d/.gitignore src/$d/package.json; done
